spec.title: Mosaic density
spec.description: Mosaic's density visualizations on Chaski: contours, 2-D and grouped densities, 1-D densities, hexbins, heatmaps and dense lines, each tab with brushes or picks that drive Grafana panels.

source.sql:
SELECT Symbol, Date, Close
FROM read_parquet('https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/data/stocks_after_2006.parquet')
WHERE Close < 100

spec.title: Penguins
spec.description: Palmer penguins the brush and the legend leave.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM $penguins WHERE $__crossfilter($penguinFilters)
SELECT avg(bill_length)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $penguins WHERE $__crossfilter($penguinFilters)
SELECT avg(bill_depth)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $penguins WHERE $__crossfilter($penguinFilters)
SELECT avg(body_mass)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $penguins WHERE $__crossfilter($penguinFilters)

spec.title: Flipper and body mass
spec.description: The plus: drag a box to pick penguins by build, or click a species in the legend. The density views and the cards follow.

options.spec:
params:
  pbrush: { select: crossfilter }

vconcat:
  - legend: color
    for: pscatter
    as: $pbrush
  - name: pscatter
    plot:
      - mark: dot
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: flipper_length
        y: body_mass
        fill: species
        r: 3
        fillOpacity: 0.85
      - select: intervalXY
        as: $pbrush
    xyDomain: Fixed
    xLabel: Flipper (mm) →
    yLabel: ↑ Body mass (g)
    marginLeft: 50
    colorDomain: [Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo]
    colorRange: ['#FF9830', '#B877D9', '#5794F2']
options.variables:
- param: pbrush
  column: [flipper_length, body_mass]
  from: [p_flip_lo, p_mass_lo]
  to: [p_flip_hi, p_mass_hi]
- param: pbrush
  column: species
  variable: p_species

spec.title: Contours
spec.description: Mosaic's contour plot: a heatmap and contour lines of bill size, one density per species, computed in DuckDB. The sliders set the smoothing and the number of contours.

options.spec:
params:
  pbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  pbandwidth: 40
  pthresholds: 10
vconcat:
  - input: slider
    label: Bandwidth (σ)
    as: $pbandwidth
    min: 1
    max: 100
  - input: slider
    label: Thresholds
    as: $pthresholds
    min: 2
    max: 20
  - plot:
      - mark: heatmap
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: bill_length
        y: bill_depth
        fill: species
        bandwidth: $pbandwidth
      - mark: contour
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: bill_length
        y: bill_depth
        stroke: species
        bandwidth: $pbandwidth
        thresholds: $pthresholds
      - mark: dot
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: bill_length
        y: bill_depth
        fill: currentColor
        r: 1
    xyDomain: Fixed
    xLabel: Bill length (mm) →
    yLabel: ↑ Bill depth (mm)
    colorDomain: [Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo]
    colorRange: ['#FF9830', '#B877D9', '#5794F2']

spec.title: Density 2D
spec.description: Mosaic's 2-D density: circle size is the local density of each species. The sliders set the smoothing and the grid.

options.spec:
params:
  pbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  p2bandwidth: 20
  p2bins: 20
vconcat:
  - input: slider
    label: Bandwidth (σ)
    as: $p2bandwidth
    min: 1
    max: 100
  - input: slider
    label: Bins
    as: $p2bins
    min: 10
    max: 60
  - plot:
      - mark: density
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: bill_length
        y: bill_depth
        r: density
        fill: species
        fillOpacity: 0.5
        width: $p2bins
        height: $p2bins
        bandwidth: $p2bandwidth
      - mark: dot
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: bill_length
        y: bill_depth
        fill: currentColor
        r: 1
    rRange: [0, 16]
    xyDomain: Fixed
    xLabel: Bill length (mm) →
    yLabel: ↑ Bill depth (mm)
    colorDomain: [Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo]
    colorRange: ['#FF9830', '#B877D9', '#5794F2']

spec.title: Density groups
spec.description: Mosaic's density groups: bill depth by species. Normalize compares shapes; stack and offset pile the areas up.

options.spec:
params:
  pbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  pgbandwidth: 20
  pnormalize: none
  pstack: false
  poffset: null
vconcat:
  - hconcat:
      - input: menu
        label: Normalize
        as: $pnormalize
        options: [none, sum, max]
      - input: menu
        label: Stack
        as: $pstack
        options: [false, true]
      - input: menu
        label: Offset
        as: $poffset
        options:
          - { label: none, value: null }
          - { label: normalize, value: normalize }
          - { label: center, value: center }
  - plot:
      - mark: densityY
        data: { from: penguins, filterBy: $pbrush }
        x: bill_depth
        fill: species
        fillOpacity: 0.45
        bandwidth: $pgbandwidth
        normalize: $pnormalize
        stack: $pstack
        offset: $poffset
    xDomain: Fixed
    xLabel: Bill depth (mm) →
    yLabel: null
    marginLeft: 50
    colorDomain: [Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo]
    colorRange: ['#FF9830', '#B877D9', '#5794F2']

spec.title: Active filters
spec.description: What the Mosaic brushes on this tab wrote to the dashboard's variables, as Chaski's cross-filters read them.

spec.rawSql: SELECT label AS Filter, value AS Range FROM $__filters($penguinFilters) WHERE active

spec.title: Flights
spec.description: Flights the brushes leave, counted by Chaski SQL.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)

spec.title: On time
spec.description: Share arriving no more than 15 minutes late.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg((delay <= 15)::INT)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)
SELECT avg(delay)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)

spec.title: Active filters
spec.description: What the Mosaic brushes on this tab wrote to the dashboard's variables, as Chaski's cross-filters read them.

spec.rawSql: SELECT label AS Filter, value AS Range FROM $__filters($flightFilters) WHERE active

spec.title: Density 1D
spec.description: Mosaic's 1-D densities of 231,000 flights: binned in DuckDB, smoothed in the browser, distance on a log scale. Drag across either to filter everything on this tab.

options.spec:
params:
  dbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  dbandwidth: 20
vconcat:
  - input: slider
    label: Bandwidth (σ)
    as: $dbandwidth
    min: 0.1
    max: 100
    step: 0.1
  - plot:
      - mark: densityY
        data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
        x: delay
        fill: '#5794F2'
        fillOpacity: 0.6
        bandwidth: $dbandwidth
      - select: intervalX
        as: $dbrush
    yAxis: null
    xDomain: Fixed
    xLabel: Arrival delay (min) →
    marginLeft: 10
  - plot:
      - mark: densityY
        data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
        x: distance
        fill: '#73BF69'
        fillOpacity: 0.6
        bandwidth: $dbandwidth
      - select: intervalX
        as: $dbrush
    yAxis: null
    xScale: log
    xDomain: Fixed
    xLabel: Distance (miles, log) →
    marginLeft: 10
options.variables:
- param: dbrush
  column: delay
  from: d_delay_lo
  to: d_delay_hi
- param: dbrush
  column: distance
  from: d_dist_lo
  to: d_dist_hi

spec.title: Hexbin
spec.description: Mosaic's hexbin of departure time and arrival delay, with marginal histograms. Drag across the departure hours on top to filter.

options.spec:
params:
  dbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  dscale: { value: log }
vconcat:
  - hconcat:
      - input: menu
        label: Color scale
        as: $dscale
        options: [log, linear, sqrt]
      - hspace: 10
      - legend: color
        for: dhexbins
  - hconcat:
      - plot:
          - mark: rectY
            data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
            x: { bin: time }
            y: { count: }
            fill: '#FF9830'
            inset: 0.5
          - select: intervalX
            as: $dbrush
        margins: { left: 5, right: 5, top: 30, bottom: 0 }
        xDomain: Fixed
        xAxis: top
        yAxis: null
        xLabel: Departure (hour)
        xLabelAnchor: center
        width: 605
        height: 70
      - hspace: 80
  - hconcat:
      - name: dhexbins
        plot:
          - mark: hexbin
            data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
            x: time
            y: delay
            fill: { count: }
            binWidth: 10
          - mark: hexgrid
            binWidth: 10
            strokeOpacity: 0.1
        colorScheme: ylgnbu
        colorScale: $dscale
        margins: { left: 5, right: 0, top: 0, bottom: 5 }
        xAxis: null
        yAxis: null
        xyDomain: Fixed
        width: 600
        height: 400
      - plot:
          - mark: rectX
            data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
            x: { count: }
            y: { bin: delay }
            fill: '#5794F2'
            inset: 0.5
        margins: { left: 0, right: 50, top: 4, bottom: 5 }
        yDomain: [-60, 180]
        xAxis: null
        yAxis: right
        yLabel: Delay (min)
        yLabelAnchor: center
        width: 80
        height: 400
options.variables:
- param: dbrush
  column: time
  from: d_time_lo
  to: d_time_hi

spec.title: Heatmap and contours
spec.description: Mosaic's flights density: a smoothed heatmap and contour lines by departure time and arrival delay. The sliders set the smoothing and the contours.

options.spec:
params:
  dbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  dhbandwidth: 7
  dhthresholds: 10
vconcat:
  - hconcat:
      - input: slider
        label: Bandwidth (σ)
        as: $dhbandwidth
        min: 1
        max: 100
      - input: slider
        label: Thresholds
        as: $dhthresholds
        min: 2
        max: 20
  - plot:
      - mark: heatmap
        data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
        x: time
        y: delay
        fill: density
        bandwidth: $dhbandwidth
      - mark: contour
        data: { from: flights, filterBy: $dbrush }
        x: time
        y: delay
        stroke: white
        strokeOpacity: 0.5
        bandwidth: $dhbandwidth
        thresholds: $dhthresholds
    colorScheme: magma
    colorScale: sqrt
    xyDomain: Fixed
    yDomain: [-60, 180]
    xLabel: Departure (hour) →
    yLabel: ↑ Arrival delay (min)

spec.title: Change, first to last month
spec.description: From the first month to the last of the stock picked; with none picked, the median over every stock.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT median(change)::DOUBLE AS v FROM (
  SELECT arg_max(Close, Date) / arg_min(Close, Date) - 1 AS change
  FROM $stocks WHERE $__crossfilter($stockFilters)
  GROUP BY Symbol
)
SELECT min(Close)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $stocks WHERE $__crossfilter($stockFilters)
SELECT max(Close)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $stocks WHERE $__crossfilter($stockFilters)

spec.title: Stocks
spec.description: Stocks in the picture: 1 with one picked.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Symbol)::DOUBLE AS v FROM $stocks WHERE $__crossfilter($stockFilters)

spec.title: Thousands of stocks, as densities
spec.description: Mosaic's line density over the monthly closes of 3,600 stocks since 2006. Lines are rasterized and summed in DuckDB, so the crowd shows as density. Drag a box on the lower plot to zoom the upper one; pick a stock to draw it on top.

options.spec:
params:
  sbrush: { select: intersect }
  ssym: { select: intersect }
  scombo: { select: intersect, include: [$sbrush, $ssym] }
  sbandwidth: 0
  spixel: 2
vconcat:
  - hconcat:
      - input: menu
        label: Stock
        as: $ssym
        from: stocks
        column: Symbol
        value: bac
      - input: slider
        label: Bandwidth (σ)
        as: $sbandwidth
        min: 0
        max: 10
        step: 0.1
      - input: menu
        label: Pixel size
        as: $spixel
        options: [0.5, 1, 2]
  - plot:
      - mark: denseLine
        data: { from: stocks, filterBy: $sbrush }
        x: Date
        y: Close
        z: Symbol
        fill: density
        bandwidth: $sbandwidth
        pixelSize: $spixel
      - mark: lineY
        data: { from: stocks, filterBy: $scombo }
        x: Date
        y: Close
        z: Symbol
        stroke: '#FF9830'
        strokeWidth: 2
    colorScheme: viridis
    colorScale: sqrt
    yLabel: ↑ Close, normalized density
    yNice: true
    margins: { left: 35, top: 20, right: 0 }
  - plot:
      - mark: denseLine
        data: { from: stocks }
        x: Date
        y: Close
        z: Symbol
        fill: density
        normalize: false
        bandwidth: $sbandwidth
        pixelSize: $spixel
      - mark: lineY
        data: { from: stocks, filterBy: $ssym }
        x: Date
        y: Close
        z: Symbol
        stroke: '#FF9830'
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      - select: intervalXY
        as: $sbrush
    colorScheme: viridis
    colorScale: sqrt
    yLabel: ↑ Close, unnormalized
    yNice: true
    margins: { left: 35, top: 20, right: 0 }
options.variables:
- param: ssym
  column: Symbol
  variable: s_symbol

options.content:
**Dense lines.** Each of the 3,600 series is drawn into a pixel grid and the grids are summed, in DuckDB, so where many stocks pass the colour is bright.

- The **upper plot normalizes each line by its length**, so a steep jump counts as much as a flat stretch; the **lower** one does not, and shows vertical streaks where prices jump.
- **Drag a box on the lower plot** to zoom the upper one into that window of time and price.
- **Pick a stock** in the menu to draw it in orange over the crowd: it starts on **bac**, Bank of America, whose fall in 2008 cuts across the whole market. The cards above follow the stock you pick.

Data: monthly closes of NYSE stocks since 2006, under $100, from [Mosaic's examples](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/line-density.html).
